text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted several horse girls gathered
around Bubblegum Fellow.

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
There's been a sudden development with the Usapy collab!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's been decided that we're going to hold an international
racing event to help promote Usapy!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a global broadcast, Team Usapy has
horse girls from all kinds of countries!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So on our side, I gathered girls who are
well-versed in overseas racing to compete!
Taiki, Kris S, Heart, glad to have you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Mission.
...If you wish it—I accept.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sure!
So, when is the event?

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yep! This weekend!
Apparently it's because of the overseas runners' schedules.

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: This weekend?
choice_data_list: I-Isn't that... a bit too tight?

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It’s no problem!
If it's us, we can do it!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The rivals this time are fierce competitors from across the globe.
...However, we have an "advantage"
that the other team lacks.

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And that is—
we're already friends!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Together, we should be able to beat any opponent!
As long as we believe in each other and bring out our best!

...An ordinary girl might hesitate with that thought,
but she was Bubblegum Fellow.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that's right.
Let's show them the power
of our friendship!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
Leave it to me. ...Leave it in our hands.

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If we're together, we can definitely win!
I'm positive of it!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Team Usapy was getting swarmed
with interviews from foreign reporters!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
For now, the goal of the collaboration: BIG SUCCESS!
Putting that aside, though~—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, even if it's a collab,
our aim is of course Victory!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble.
...Give us—the word.

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Here we go then!
I declare!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "Our team will be the ones to win"!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeah!

And so the exhibition race began.
The result ended in a spectacular
and overwhelming victory for Bubblegum Fellow's team.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your victory!
That was truly a marvelous race.

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
I hope everyone all over the world
enjoyed watching too!

text_block_list.name: Usapy
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Bubble-chan!
Let's continue bringing fun to the entire world together♪

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Usapy! You bet.
No matter where people are,
let's deliver smiles and fun to them!

Some time after that.
I saw her researching something in the library.
choice_data_list: What kind of dream are you chasing this time?
What kind of dream are you chasing this time?

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Meeting Usapy in person made me realize.
Meeting Usapy face-to-face really is the best!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So I thought... If we apply our Umalator tech,
maybe anyone anywhere in the world
could meet Usapy...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just imagine it! Meeting Usapy anywhere in the world
as long as you have an internet connection—

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Next time, anyone will be able to do
a VR collab with Usapy and me!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That being said, I have to understand how Umalator tech
works first, so I'm studying up!

text_block_list.name: Bubblegum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm gonna pull this off!

Even hearing such a massive dream,
strangely enough, I wasn't surprised at all.

If it's her, she will surely make it a reality...
I couldn't help but feel that way.
